title: Location
description: Represents a physical location where collection items can be stored.

name.description: The name of the location (e.g., Living Room Bookshelf, Storage Box).

description.description: A description of the location. Provides users with more information about each location.

attachmentUrl.description: A upload url to attach a file to an item or location depending on the request parameter.

locationId.description: A physical location where the item is stored.
